name: Art-direction lock
oneLiner: Generate one style-reference sheet for the game (a character, a prop, a floor patch and an item), lock it, and pass it as a reference image to every later generation, so all generated bitmaps share one light, outline, palette and proportions; the game loads the saved files once at boot and draws them synchronously, falling back to its old art when one is missing.
fits: any game moving from code-drawn to painted HD art
notFor: pixel-art styles (pixel8, pixel16, handheld4): generated art needs a snapping and palette pass first (planned L-08)
games that need art generated at runtime (no generator is called by the game)
exact reproduction of a look by prompt alone (there is no seed)

needs: the game's boot function (first step, ?t= fast-forward, first animation frame), moved into the onReady callback
each draw site to replace: hero, props, floor, item icons, with its drawn size and foot point in canvas px
optional: skins/skin-api.js v0.5 to route tile / prop / frame / icon / portrait / bg-layer roles
provides: GameDNA_Assets.get(key) / draw / drawFrame / fillTiled: synchronous bitmaps with anchor, baseline and grid metadata
GameDNA_Skin.bitmaps registration (useAssets) so skins draw bitmaps for tile, prop, frame9, icon, portrait, bg-layer roles
assets.json manifest: prompt, GEN.md, model, date and sha256 of every shipped file
tools/assets: gen.sh, namecheck.py, postproc.py, assetcheck.py, stylestats.py, genmeta.py

promptParams.default: 2 for an HD canvas, 1 for a fixed low-resolution canvas

assets: module/art-direction-lock.js: GameDNA_Assets loader (one global, no dependencies)
assets/assets.json: manifest of 18 generated files (WebP), with prompts, GEN.md, meta and sha256 per Codex run under assets/gen/
assets/prompts/: style lock, sheet, derived-asset briefs and the general templates.md
tools/assets/ (shared): gen.sh, genmeta.py, namecheck.py + blocklist.txt, postproc.py, assetcheck.py, stylestats.py
